resources.string: Polish audio (lektor/dubbing) is used for the Dub option; Sub uses Polish, then English, subtitles. Only embeddable hosts work, links to services such as Crunchyroll or Netflix are skipped.

If your language is not offered by the source, subtitles are machine translated on your device. Language packs (about 30 MB each) are downloaded once from Google; after that translation runs fully on-device and no subtitle text leaves your phone. Translated subtitles are labelled \"machine translated\".
